2026_02_PIT_NE.headline: Receiver and secondary absences sharpen the pressure battle in Pittsburgh–New England
2026_02_PIT_NE.paragraph1: Pittsburgh will be without receiver Michael Pittman Jr. and cornerback Joey Porter Jr., while tackle Troy Fautanu remains questionable. New England has its own losses with tackle Dametrious Crownover and cornerback Carlton Davis III ruled out. Those absences put extra weight on protection and depth: the Patriots must keep Pittsburgh’s pressure from wrecking their passing rhythm, while the Steelers need replacement receivers to separate against a New England secondary also missing a starter.
2026_02_PIT_NE.model_rationale: Pass protection and replacement-player execution are central on both sides, with Pittsburgh’s pressure packages and each offense’s ability to exploit a thinned secondary likely deciding efficiency.
